title: Monotonicity of a hyperbolic sine ratio
statement: Let $a\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $0\le a\le 1$. The function $u\mapsto \operatorname{sinh}(au)/\operatorname{sinh}(u)$ is nonincreasing for $u>0$; equivalently, if $0<u\le v$, then $\operatorname{sinh}(av)/\operatorname{sinh}(v)\le \operatorname{sinh}(au)/\operatorname{sinh}(u)$.
replaced: For $0\le a\le1$, the function $u\mapsto\sinh(au)/\sinh u$ is nonincreasing on $(0,\infty)$.
